race.comment: Tricky. ONAVUITTON (4) presents third up and should be at peak fitness. He made good improvement up to 1400m second up at Cranbourne when finding the line strongly and if he can hold a spot from the inside gate he'll be hard to hold out. OLE ROYALE (1) struggled at Geelong last start but had won well at Ballarat fresh. Better for that run at 1400m and can improve. OROVERO (5) resumes. He placed in all three runs last time in, including over this trip at Pakenham first up. Watch the betting off a fairly long break. RUSSIAN CHOICE (9) was dominant from the front winning at Geelong last start and will look to adopt similar tactics here if left alone. JAMESJOHNO (10) resumed with a good run at Bendigo and looks a live chance.
